notes: Pre-vote intelligence beat. Fires when the player's bill is approaching a floor vote and the whip's count is soft. Speaker: Petra Solis — Shadow Power archetype, recurring (established in intro-aide-dialogue.json). Purpose: introduce the whip-count mechanic; give the player advance intelligence that their coalition is fragile and force a stance decision before the vote locks. Two choice points: (1) how the player receives the count intelligence — absorb without question, challenge the count, or probe for the specific defector (Connections ≥ 3 gate); (2) the player's declared plan — work the room themselves, ask the Whip to intervene directly, or dismiss the count as routine fluctuation. Branch-specific flags (whip-warned-working, whip-warned-escalated, whip-warned-dismissed) are observable by the floor-vote outcome event. Universal completion flag: whip-count-warning-complete. No faction effects authored — defers to OQ-A (faction-standing kind) pending Sol resolution. 'senator-lim' referenced in petra-partial is a new named NPC placeholder — not in GDD §12.3.4 seed list — TODO(vex): confirm whether Lim should be a recurring NPC or remain a name-drop placeholder (OQ-W4-A). 'thursday' deadline referenced in plan-ask is a procedural text placeholder — TODO(vex): confirm whether dialogue trees should reference relative time markers or game-calendar tokens (OQ-W4-B). See intro-aide-dialogue-notes.md Content wave 4 for all open questions.

open.speaker: narrator
open.text: Petra Solis materializes in the hallway between committee hearings. No appointment. She has a folder. She doesn't hand it to you.

opening-line.speaker: petra-solis
opening-line.text: Your count is wrong. The Whip asked me to tell you before the floor schedule locks.

count-detail.speaker: petra-solis
count-detail.text: You're four votes soft. Three of those are firm flips — contacted and answered. The fourth we're still reading.

options.label: Understood. I'll work from your numbers.
Your count and mine don't match. Show me the gap.
Which of the three has already committed the other direction?
options.failureHint: Requires Connections 3. You haven't been in Washington long enough to know who talks to whom.

petra-stands-firm.speaker: petra-solis
petra-stands-firm.text: My count is current as of this morning. Yours isn't. That's why we're having this conversation.

petra-partial.speaker: petra-solis
petra-partial.text: Senator Lim. She told two people. We know one of them. Now you do too.

plan-ask.speaker: petra-solis
plan-ask.text: The Whip wants to know what you're doing about the four before Thursday.

options.label: I'm making calls tonight. My count will be back before the morning brief.
Ask Vance to apply direct pressure on the firm flips. She can close this faster.
Four votes is movement, not a deficit. The count will settle.

exit-working.speaker: petra-solis
exit-working.text: I'll tell the Whip you're on it.

exit-escalated.speaker: petra-solis
exit-escalated.text: I'll pass that back. She'll want to know what you're asking her to spend.

exit-cold.speaker: petra-solis
exit-cold.text: Every count moves until the roll call. That's when it's final.

exit.speaker: narrator
exit.text: She's gone before the folder changes hands.
